source: Mainnet ledger 107862214 from s1.ripple.com, 2026-10-24: `ledger` with transactions, expand and binary (API v1); and one transaction's branch, each inner node on its path as its sixteen children's hashes, root first. Also two branches of transactions in other mainnet ledgers, from `tx` with binary, with their ledgers' headers in binary, written from `ledger`'s fields, and four ledger objects with their keys, from `ledger_entry` with binary. Reproduced by testdata/xrpl/capture-transaction-set.mjs --ledger 107862214 --branch 73 --objects 107862238.
